name: AI-Agent-Blocking
title: AI Agent Blocking Template
summary: Denies sign-in to AI agents that identify themselves with Web Bot Auth.
preRequisites: Modify the authentication option(s) from defaults as required.
AI agents are identified by their Web Bot Auth headers (Signature, Signature-Input and Signature-Agent). Make sure your load balancers and proxies forward them to the server.
To identify AI agents that do not use Web Bot Auth, extend detectAgent(). See the documentation for examples.
code: // This script denies sign-in when the request comes from an AI agent.
// AI agents that use Web Bot Auth sign every request with HTTP Message Signatures and declare themselves
// in the Signature-Agent header. To identify other AI agents, extend detectAgent().
// See the documentation for more identification methods.
var errorMessage = 'AI agents are not allowed to sign in to this application.';
Log.info('AI agent blocked for application: ' + context.serviceProviderName);
// Returns true when the request comes from an AI agent that identifies itself with Web Bot Auth.
// Signed agents send a Signature-Agent header and a Signature-Input header with tag="web-bot-auth".
// The declaration is enough to deny or step up an agent. Verify the signature (for example at your edge)
// Match the tag parameter exactly, e.g. sig1=(...);tag="web-bot-auth".
